name: Non-Catholic Denominations
desc: Benson's survey of 1910 of the non-Catholic religions of England: in Part I the Established Church (the High Church, Ritualist, extreme, Low Church and Broad Church parties) and in Part II the non-episcopal sects: Presbyterians, Nonconformists, Congregationalists, Wesleyans, Quakers and modern mystics.
desc_pt: O panorama de Benson (1910) das religiões não católicas da Inglaterra: na Parte I a Igreja Estabelecida (partidos High Church, ritualista, extremo, Low Church e Broad Church) e na Parte II as seitas não episcopais: presbiterianos, não conformistas, congregacionalistas, wesleyanos, quacres e místicos modernos.
editor: Robert Hugh Benson (London: Catholic Truth Society, 1910)
edition: Non-Catholic Denominations (London: Catholic Truth Society, 1910), Internet Archive full-text OCR (tnoncatholicdenom00bensuoft).
